title: Complete Streets — Core Overview (Edition 1)
description: Complete streets are designed for everyone, including pedestrians, cyclists, transit riders, and drivers, with sidewalks, bike lanes, and safe crossings. The design approach reduces crashes by separating modes and calming traffic. This overview edition presents Complete Streets as a core mobility concept for contemporary cities.

real_examples.fact: More than fifteen hundred jurisdictions have adopted complete-streets policies.

spec.source_note: Core facts verified from public sources.
